SELECT DISTINCT
    e."id",
    e."name",
    e."event_space",
    e."capacity",
    e."address",
    e."contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces" e
WHERE
    e."event_space" IN ('Banquet Hall', 'Conference Room')
    AND e."capacity" >= 200;
2:
SELECT
    "id",
    "name",
    "event_space",
    "capacity",
    "address",
    "contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    LOWER(TRIM("event_space")) IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room')
    AND "capacity" >= 200;
4:
SELECT DISTINCT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" = 'Café' AND
    r."cuisine" = 'Italian'

UNION ALL

SELECT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" != 'Café' OR
    r."cuisine" != 'Italian';

    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    LOWER(r."cuisine") = 'italian'
    AND r."food_service" IN ('Restaurant', 'Café');

SELECT s."id", s."name", s."role", s."language"
FROM "staff" s
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(s."role")) = 'chef'

UNION ALL


SELECT s."id", s."name", s."role", s."language"
FROM "staff" s
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(s."role")) = 'server'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(s."language")) = 'english';
7:

       s."name",
       s."role",
       s."language"
FROM "staff" s
WHERE LOWER(s."role") IN ('chef', 'server')
  AND LOWER(s."language") = 'english';
8:
SELECT s."name" AS chef_name
FROM "staff" s
WHERE LOWER(s."role") = 'chef'
  AND LOWER(s."language") = 'english'

UNION ALL


SELECT s."name" || ' speaks ' || s."language" AS server_language
FROM "staff" s
WHERE LOWER(s."role") = 'server';
109:
SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    STRING_AGG(s."system_name", ', ' ORDER BY s."system_name") AS systems
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
LEFT JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
LEFT JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
GROUP BY
    its."id", its."name"
ORDER BY
    its."id";
110:
SELECT
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active",
    its."name" AS "it_specialist_name"
FROM
    "systems" s
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" iss ON s."system_id" = iss."system_id"
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists" its ON iss."it_specialist_id" = its."id"
ORDER BY
    its."name", s."system_name";
111:
SELECT
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."name", s."system_name";
112:
WITH internship_responsibility_counts AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS internship_count
    FROM
        "responsibilities" r
    JOIN
        "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY
        r."responsibility"
),
total_internships AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "id") AS total FROM "internships"
)
SELECT
    r."responsibility"
FROM
    internship_responsibility_counts r
CROSS JOIN
    total_internships t
WHERE
    r.internship_count = t.total;

    r."responsibility" AS responsibility
FROM

261:
SELECT
    j."minimum_years",
    j."preferred_years"
FROM
    "jobs" j
ORDER BY
    j."salary" DESC
LIMIT 1;
262:
SELECT
    "p"."title" AS "position_title",
    "sd"."salary_range" AS "compensation_range",
    "sd"."hourly_rate" AS "hourly_rate"
FROM
    "position" "p"
JOIN
    "salarydetails" "sd" ON "p"."id" = "sd"."positionid"
WHERE
    LOWER("p"."title") = LOWER('Software Developer');
263:
SELECT
    "sd"."hourly_rate" AS "expected_hourly_rate"
FROM
    "salarydetails" "sd"
JOIN
    "position" "p" ON "sd"."positionid" = "p"."id"
WHERE
    LOWER("p"."title") = LOWER('Software Developer')
LIMIT 1;
264:
SELECT
    p."title" AS job_position,
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range
FROM
    "position" p
LEFT JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid";
266:
WITH max_salary_job AS (
    SELECT
        "jobid",
        "minimum_years",
        "preferred_years"
    FROM
        "jobs"
    ORDER BY
        "salary" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    "minimum_years" AS minimum_required_experience_years,
    "preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years
FROM
    max_salary_job;
